explanation.1_hardGates: B-1/B-2/B-3 hard gates (typed, never clamped) on every access candidate: plan separation >= 6 x width (30 m), rock pillar >= 2 x width (10 m) judged beyond the geometry-derived turnout taper s* (~25.3-26.4 m; terminal always judged - replaces commit O's fixed 15 m exclusion, which under-reported every helix branch because tangential divergence from a curving winding is quadratic), and turnout curvature <= 100 deg over +/-25 m. Feasible counts drop everywhere (12 -> 2 TABULAR/CUT_AND_FILL, 10 -> 4 WARPED-301, 10 -> 3 IRREGULAR): hard constraints, not score penalties.
explanation.2_winners: TABULAR/CUT_AND_FILL winner returns to SWITCHBACK-k2-p+20-CW-g0.120 (the commit-C SPIRAL winner fails the gates: its branches cannot hold the pillar); per-level pillar 10.2-16.1 m, planSep 33.2-39.4 m, turnout 23-52 deg, branch 66-91 m. WARPED-301 and IRREGULAR stay SUCCESS with SPIRAL-n1-CCW-e+0-g0.120: pillar 10.1-13.8 m, planSep 34-59 m, turnout 81-91 deg (a gentle helix passes the 100 deg gate by design; the gate rejects near-minimum-radius turns only).
explanation.3_stressStarvationProven: GEOMETRY-STRESS becomes NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE - and the B-5 diagnostic PROVES assignment starvation, not geometry: the best candidate SWITCHBACK-k1-p-20-CCW-g0.120 reaches 18/21 valid accesses and its three failing levels (L03/L05/L07) all report starvationSuspected=true (valid candidates exist once the junction spacing already consumed by shallower levels is ignored). Per the directive, this phase only distinguishes (a) geometry from (b) starvation; the deterministic assignment backtracking that would recover such levels is Phase 20C scope. No constraint was relaxed.
explanation.4_accessInfeasibleCase: ACCESS-INFEASIBLE (15-16 m length window) stays 0 feasible by design; its dominant typed reason can shift (the B gates run before the length checks) - still a typed, inspectable failure per level.
explanation.5_metricRedefinition: excavationSeparation / rampCenterlineDistance now use the SAME taper exclusion as the B-2 gate (s*, terminal always judged) instead of commit O's fixed 15 m, so gate and metric share one definition; winner columns therefore jump from ~0/negative to >= 10 m by construction.
explanation.6_307: WARPED-307 unchanged: NO_FEASIBLE_CANDIDATE for the commit-C proven geometric reasons.
